text:
maria: Quick heads-up — planning to deploy runtime-config-v3 today during the quiet window at 18:00 UTC. Need a quick preflight signoff and smoke owners. TL;DR: 18:00 UTC, 30m ramp, canary 5% -> 25% -> 100%.

alex: I can own the deploy step (apply k8s manifest + toggle runtime flag). Will be on-call at that time.

samira: I'll run smoke tests and perf sanity after each canary step. Test plan: auth flow, streaming 1k tokens, embed pipeline.

zach: Do we have rollback image/tag handy? If we hit errors, who's the rollback owner?

maria: rollback image is runtime-config-v2-2026-03-15 (tag: v2-20260315). @raj is rollback owner + will coordinate DB fallback if needed.

raj: @maria @alex got it — I'll be reachable and will approve rollback. Keep me in the channel when you start canaries.

alex: checklist (quick):
```
- pre-deploy: all green on staging smoke
- infra: nodes >= 15, free GPU mem >= 50% on pool-a
- secrets: KMS rotation check done
- telemetry: tracing + slow-query alerts enabled
- rollback: v2 tag tested locally
```

samira: Staging smoke results: auth ok, stream p95 210ms, tokens/sec normal. Minor warning on one shard (OOM in job-runner), but unrelated to runtime-config. I'll re-run heatmap at 17:30 UTC.

deploy-bot: Scheduled deploy: runtime-config-v3 -> cluster-prod at 2024-06-25T18:00:00Z. Canary plan: 5% @t+0, 25% @t+10m, 100% @t+20m. Notifying owners: alex, samira, raj.

maria: Can we add a smoke checklist for each canary stage? Simple checks: health endpoints, 1 sample request, background job queue length, error rate spike >0.5% -> pause.

alex: I have a small script for health checks. Running it locally now, will push to ops-runbooks if it looks good.

samira: Copy of the smoke commands I will run: 
```
curl -fsS https://prod.example/health || exit 1
python ./tools/send_sample_request.py --model test-model --timeout 60
kubectl get pods -n prod -l app=runtime | grep CrashLoopBackOff || true
```

zach: FYI I've set alerting to reduce noise: only page if error-rate spike > 1% and P0 latency SLO breached. Otherwise post to paging slack.

maria: Approvals: @alex (deploy) ✅, @samira (smoke) ✅, @raj (rollback) ✅. Anyone else? @security?

raj: security gave implicit approval — no schema changes, just flag toggles. I'll PM if anything risky pops up.

alex: I'll start the first canary at 18:00 UTC and post updates here. If anything looks odd I'll pause at 5% and escalate.

samira: I'll post smoke results after each stage, short status like: "smoke OK (5%): auth ok, p95 220ms, errors 0.02%"

maria: sweet. final note — keep the channel quiet during the window unless action required. :pray: Good luck team.

alex: :thumbsup: starting on time.

samira: acknowledged — will monitor.

raj: standing by.

deploy-bot: Deploy started: runtime-config-v3 -> prod (canary 5%).

alex: canary 5% applied. posting smoke in 2m.

samira: smoke OK (5%): auth ok, p95 225ms, errors 0.01%. No regressions. Proceeding to 25%.

maria: thanks — proceeding with ramp.

deploy-bot: Canary increased to 25%.

samira: smoke OK (25%): auth ok, p95 230ms, errors 0.02%. No DB anomalies.

alex: going to 100% now.

deploy-bot: Canary complete — 100% rollout applied.

samira: final smoke OK (100%): all good. Closing monitoring window in 10m.

maria: thanks everyone — roll complete. Leaving rollback flag until EOD. :white_check_mark:
